{{EventEnd|The April Fools 2025 Event|date = 9th of April 2025}} {{AprilFoolsInfobox |image1 = V1.59.0Render.png |dates = 1 April 2025 – 9 April 2025 |reruns_included = [[April Fools 2024 Event]] |previous_edition = [[April Fools 2024 Event|Skibidi 2024]] |next_edition = [[Aprilini Foolsini Eventini|Aprilini Foolsini 2026]] |previous_event=[[The Hunt: Mega Edition Event|The Hunt: Mega Edition]] |next_event = [[Ducky Revenge Event]] }} ==Description== The '''April Fools 2025 Event''', also known as the '''Baseplate Event''', was the sixth April Fools edition and the twenty-first event to be added in Tower Defense Simulator. It is the second April Fools edition to be considered an event, as it contained a rerun of [[Headache Headquarters]]. The event is partially a rerun of [[Headache Headquarters]] from the [[April Fools 2024 Event]] with minor changes. When it first started, only [[Headache Headquarters]] was available. All other parts of the event were added a few hours later, the same day in [[v1.59.0]]. Multiple parts of the event were removed briefly in [[v1.59.0|v1.59.1]] but then re-added in [[v1.59.0|v1.59.2]]. The baseplate lobby was removed around 12 hours after it was added. At the same time, the [[April fools 2025]] modifier was removed from all games, except [[Baseplate-L]] and [[Baseplate-W]]. Later, on the 8th of April 2025, [[Headache Headquarters]] would become unavailable. On the 9th of April 2025, [[Baseplate-L]] and [[Baseplate-W]] would be removed from [[Elevators]] and the [[Index]].
